subject: Request to clear a waste dump on a vacant plot in Jodhpur (JunkSnap site site_jdh_1)
body:
To the Commissioner, Jodhpur Municipal Corporation.

Residents have reported a waste dump on a vacant plot in Jodhpur, at 26.2618 N, 73.0035 E. Seven reports since 9 October 2026, six of them verified, show mixed household waste and plastic packets. Blurred photos: https://d111111abcdef8.cloudfront.net/media/reports/rpt_jdh_1.jpg

Rule 15(1) of the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 states: "SAMPLE QUOTE for mock mode; the real text comes from the hashed official copy." Rule 39(2)(vii) states: "SAMPLE QUOTE for mock mode; the real text comes from the hashed official copy."

We request that the site be cleared and that a bin or collection point be provided nearby.

This letter is filed by a resident. Copies go for attention to the MLA for Jodhpur and the MP for Jodhpur.
